schedule.requests: Monthly queue mode2 first, annual mode3 second. Both kind0,parameter0,sound100,variant0.
schedule.queue: 0x8003ecd8 scans slots1..49 for these modes, first free. Full queue returns-1; caller does not retry within this scheduling block.
schedule.consumer: 0x8003ef44 processes first active queue slot when active-display state0x801398b4==0, then clears slot active byte. Metrics are calculated at consumption, not frozen when enqueued.
schedule.display: Annual mode starts display-active1 and duration counter240; do not call this seconds without frame-clock evidence.

aggregation.own_stores: Scan10 records at0x8012b2f8, stride5080; signed active byte!=0 and flagsu16+4 bit15 clear.
aggregation.previous_annual_sales: Read signed32 +0xd0c. On summing two positive values, signed positive overflow clamps running total to0x7fffffff. Other signed32 additions wrap.
aggregation.evaluation: Read signed32+0xc68, sum signed32 and divide by own store count truncating toward zero; +0xc6c popularity is a different field.
aggregation.population: Call0x80020498 with category0: all 3000 town cells and all valid customer profile ids except-1, five signed16 counts per referenced mix. Do not replace with residential-only category3 population.
aggregation.visitors: Unsigned32 cumulative entered customer quantity at0x800cd930, updated after own-store gate in arrival path; not completed purchases, not reset at annual ledger rollover.

year_rollover.ledger: Current-year5-word block+0xce8 is shifted into previous-year+0xcfc then cleared. Previous-year revenue is+0xcfc+16=+0xd0c.
year_rollover.order: Daily/month/year finance close is before monthly town growth; scheduling0x8003ceac is later. Queue consumer occurs earlier in each outer update, so newly scheduled annual report is consumed in a later update after finance/year shift.
year_rollover.note: Population and evaluation are live at consumption; completion and natural growth can have already changed town inputs. Annual report must not be precomputed from raw initial files.

metrics.label: 年商
metrics.value_source: saturating sum of store+0xd0c previous annual ledger revenue

metrics.label: 町人口
metrics.value_source: population(0): all town categories, signed16 profile counts

metrics.label: 店舗評価
metrics.value_source: trunc(sum of store+0xc68 evaluation / active own store count)

scoring.raw_total: sum of five points; displayed total=100 if raw>=96 else raw
scoring.bounds: Normal positive own store count1..10. Zero own stores causes original divide-by-zero in this consumer; no synthetic score0 asserted.

completion.normal_score: raw2*store_count+four band scores. raw>=96 becomes100; else keep raw.
completion.scenario2: When displayed score==100 and signed mode0x800cd948==2: unlock byte0x800cd8a0 |=4; pending0x800cd9b4=2.
completion.scenario3: When displayed score==100 and signed mode==3: unlock|=8; pending=3.
completion.ten_store_goal: Separate0x8003ead4 milestone: exactly10 own active stores while mode1 sets unlock|=2,pending1. This must not force the annual100 threshold to require10 stores.
completion.other_modes: Annual scoring does not set the above scenario2/3 endings in other modes.

limitations: Original annual consumer divides by active own count without zero guard. Raw initial maps have no own store. No claim that a zero-store annual report is valid normal play.
Seven perfect-score cases are derived band combinations, not observed natural-year completions.
Project population bounds are independent static replacements, not a trajectory including natural town growth.
